segments.text: For a score, hold up, I lost a page in the back
But I remember why we came, so I'm bringing it back
A long time back on this land in a storm
Some people drew a line and a country was born
Said every soul got a right to arrive
Not just survive, but be seen alive
Now the field got smoked where the young ones fell
Names in the dirt and a hard bell
Now I ain't dressed in a suit, ain't reciting it clean
But the weight of those words still cut through the scene
They said freedom, but the road stayed steep
Promises buried where the family's weak
I'm trying to say what the old speech meant
You can't call it a union if the people get bent
So I'm talking to the crowd with the paper gone black
For the worker, the widow, the kid by the tank
For whoever got told they were less than a man
This nation always stands when it honors the plan
Four scores still standing here, the ground's off that
No crown on the people, no hand on the neck
We came through fire, we remember the cost
Veiled for the living, don't abandon the loss
I forgot the exact line but I know that it's sad
What we do with the future belongs to the dead
Not because they can rule us from under the clay
But they paid for a morning we can't throw away
Dedicated crown, yeah, that's what I mean
Not some fancy little phrase for a polished machine
The ground gets holy when the people give all
And the ones left breathing answer the call
No marble speech can make a wrong thing right
No flag by itself can carry the fight
It's the hands that repair what the damage took down
It's the vote, it's the voice, it's the block
It's the town, government, other people
Wait, let me get straight
Not a private little club behind a garden gate
By the people, for the people, that's the heartbeat loud
If it vanishes, we failed every name in the crowd
Four score still standing here, the ground talk back
No crown on the people, no hand on the neck
We came through fire, we remember the cost
Build for the living, don't abandon the loss
I'm not Lincoln, I'm a man with a beat and a blur
Trying to hold every promise inside of one word
Maybe I stumbled, maybe the history slips
But I won't let the meaning fall out of my lips
A new birth to freedom, I remember that part
Not a slogan for a wall, it's a charge to the heart
Let the nation be tested, let the powerful see
No democracy lives if it won't keep us free
So gather at the field where the silence is deep
Tell the children the truth, let the memory key
There were lives cut short, there were futures denied
There were mothers who waiting with the door open
Why we can honor the fallen without love and war
We can carry that lesson and demand something more
That equality ain't decoration for a speech
It's bread on the table and a world within reach
When the loud ones divide us for a vote or a dime
We remember the measure, we remember the time
Not perfect at birth, but still able to grow
If we fight for the promise that we already know
I lost the words, but the message stayed near
Let the people be heard, let the people be here
Let the work be unfinished, let the future be ours
From a blood-soaked field to the streetlights and towers
Four scores still standing, let the whole world know
From the ground where they fell, we got farther to go
For the people, by the people, keep the flame in view
A free land survives when it makes room for you
I lost the page, but I carried the truth
Let this nation become what it said it could be
And let freedom keep breathing through you and me
Through you and me, still standing free
You
